WHAT IS AND IS NOT FREE
Below 996px Docusaurus already turns the sidebar into a drawer, hides the TOC and gives content the full width. None of that needed designing.

These boards cover only what it does not decide: every section of the landing page (all custom React), where the version selector lives once the sidebar is a drawer, and how content wider than the screen behaves.

The desktop boards use ~30px rows, which fail the 44px touch floor. tokens.css raises them at the breakpoint rather than making desktop loose.

DECIDED
Nucleus. The mark now runs through every board on the Pages tab.

Four SVG files are cut and sent separately. The favicon is a genuinely different drawing — same geometry, heavier weights — because the 2.6 axon falls under one device pixel at 16px. Compare the two rows on the board.

THE DARK THEME RULE
The hero band does not change. In dark mode its own colour (#17123A) becomes the page surface, and everything that was white drops to #0F0B24 beneath it.

So the band stops reading as a band and becomes the ground — compare the two boards at the navbar and they are identical.

WHERE THE DISPLAY FACE STOPS
Bricolage Grotesque carries the page title and every h2. From h3 down the page switches to Plus Jakarta Sans bold.

Scroll this board: "Heartbeat protocol" and "Token idempotency" are the display face; "Applying a command" is not. A long reference page stacks a dozen of the smaller ones, and the display face turns noisy at that size.

CONTRAST
Every text/ground pair on the System page is measured and clears WCAG AA. The brand violet flips across themes — #5F3DF2 for links on white, #A98CFF on dark — while the button fill stays #5F3DF2 in both, because white-on-violet clears AA either way.
